card_config.title: Card Configuration (Optional)
card_config.description: Provide your RFID card ID to enable remote start/stop of charging sessions. You can leave this blank and it will be auto-detected from your next charging session.

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure EVC-net
reconfigure.description: Update your EVC-net connection credentials. Leave password blank to keep current password.

otp.title: Verify email code
otp.description: Enter the six-digit code sent by EVC-net. If the code has expired, restart authentication to request a new code.

reauth_confirm.title: Authenticate EVC-net again
reauth_confirm.description: Your session expired. Submit to request a new email code. Leave the password blank to reuse your saved password.

error.invalid_url: Enter an HTTPS origin, without a path, query or credentials.
error.invalid_otp: Invalid or expired code. Try again or restart authentication.
error.invalid_response: Unexpected response from EVC-net. The EVC-net log entry contains the request step and HTTP status, without credentials.
error.server_error: EVC-net returned a server error (HTTP 5xx). Check the EVC-net log entry for the exact status and request step.
error.rate_limited: EVC-net is limiting login requests (HTTP 429). Wait before trying again.
error.missing_redirect: The login redirect has no destination. Check the EVC-net log entry.
error.cross_origin_redirect: EVC-net redirected to a different website address. Check the configured base URL; for 50five NL use https://50five-snl.evc-net.com.
error.missing_otp_token: The verification page does not contain the expected hidden _token field. Check the EVC-net log entry.
error.otp_page_unavailable: The email verification page could not be loaded. Check the EVC-net log entry.

abort.challenge_expired: Verification session expired. Restart authentication to request a new code.

init.title: EVC-net Options
init.description: Update your RFID card ID and customer ID. These are used to start charging sessions remotely. Leave blank to use auto-detected values.
